scientific_question: When the donor MLP's complete c_fc-to-GELU-to-c_proj function is kept intact, can at most four donor MLP layers improve the joint full-procedural-MLP checkpoint on two untouched validation windows?

isolated_cproj_transplant.conclusion: Every isolated dense c_proj transplant was catastrophic, showing that the donor tensor cannot be separated from its learned hidden-coordinate gauge.

evidence.causal_distinction: This oracle preserves each donor MLP's internal hidden-coordinate gauge and tests residual-stream compatibility. It does not transplant c_proj in isolation and does not train a mixed architecture.

analysis.donor_function: Replace transformer.h.{layer}.mlp as a complete module for the evaluation arm, so c_fc, GELU, c_proj, gains, biases, procedural coordinates, and any registered MLP buffers remain in the donor's learned internal gauge.

variants.donor_control: Evaluate the unchanged donor checkpoint on the exact same batches.
variants.all12_functional_patch: Evaluate the joint transformer with all twelve complete donor MLP modules temporarily installed.
variants.single_layer_functional_patches: Temporarily install one complete donor MLP module and rank primary-window CE gain, breaking ties by smaller layer index.
variants.primary_ranked_cumulative: Evaluate cumulative top-k sets for k in [1,2,3,4,6,8,10,12] on both windows. Confirmation tokens never change the ordering.

analysis.restore_contract: After every arm, restore the exact original joint MLP module object at every selected layer. Require original module identities, parameter identities, and parameter values to remain unchanged; require donor module fingerprints to remain unchanged.
prohibited: mixing donor and joint components inside one MLP

decision_rule.pass: Select the smallest cumulative k in ascending order that clears every control and candidate requirement. A pass authorizes only a separately preregistered jointly trained mixed-MLP implementation plan, correctness tests, and exact-config MFU preflight.
decision_rule.fail: Reject post-hoc whole-MLP functional layer allocation as nonportable. Do not tune seeds, thresholds, donor/joint interpolation, or subsets after measurement.

execution_policy.mfu_gate: not applicable to a zero-update terminal counterfactual
